EmailTemplate.name: Trustpilot Second Email
EmailTemplate.subject: Your Opinion Matters to Us
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
We are very pleased to have you as a National Funding customer, and we hope the feeling is mutual. You should have received an email recently from trustpilot.com asking you to rate and review your recent experience with National Funding. Thank you very much for leaving your feedback on Trustpilot if you have already done so; we greatly appreciate it.
If you haven't already left a review, we would really appreciate you sharing your feedback through this 1-minute survey on Trustpilot's website: https://www.trustpilot.com/evaluate/nationalfunding.com.
Thank you again for financing your business with National Funding, we look forward to helping you again with any future business financing needs.
Sincerely, National Funding
